claim.quote: Independent of interaction channels, this result contradicts the interpretation that the anomalous excesses of the CoGeNT experiment are induced by Dark Matter, since identical detector techniques are used in both experiments.

name: Limits on light WIMPs from the CDEX-1 experiment with a p-type point-contact germanium detector at the China Jingping Underground Laboratory

summary.plain: CDEX-1, using the same kind of detector as CoGeNT, found no dark matter and said CoGeNT's excess is unlikely to be caused by dark matter.
summary.technical: 53.9 kg-days from a p-type point-contact germanium detector enclosed by a NaI(Tl) anti-Compton detector; event rate and spectrum above the 475 eVee threshold consistent with the background model; part of the allowed regions for WIMP-nucleus coherent elastic scattering at 6-20 GeV is excluded.

title: Limits on light WIMPs from the CDEX-1 experiment with a p-type point-contact germanium detector at the China Jingping Underground Laboratory
why_it_matters: States directly that it contradicts the dark-matter interpretation of CoGeNT's anomalous excess.
